title: The Flagellants
sentences: Thousands of people marched across Europe whipping themselves bloody.
They believed the plague was God's punishment, and that their suffering could end it.
A procession often lasted thirty-three and a half days, one for each year of Christ's life.
In 1349, the Pope condemned the movement.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
